decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - 10.2	The application for the erection of a single storey rear and side extension with link to workshop to create a new office and washroom facilities to the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers 01-05, 02-05, 03-05, 04-05 and 05-05, received 18 October 2005, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and it would maintain the appearance and character of Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development is consistent with the objectives of the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted for a utility room, home office and washroom, shall not be used at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 12 Staveley Road, Chiswick, London W4 3ES. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling or office accommodation.
description: Erection of a single storey rear and side extension with a link to workshop to create a new office and washroom facilities to house
